scope: Synthetic local prompt-cache diagnostic; not end-to-end tutor latency or quality evidence
isolation: Separate loopback Ollama process, cloud disabled, no learner database; process terminated and port closed
prompt: One-sentence instruction followed by 40 synthetic group-retention examples and an identical question in every run.
limitations: Two empty preparation requests only; same prompt and model throughout.
First baseline includes cold-run setup; subsequent calls have warm prompt cache.
24-token cap intentionally truncates answers; no semantic or completion-quality claim.
Shared Mac resources and weight cache; not an isolated hardware benchmark.
